yontem.ne: Claude kullanarak borsa verilerini analiz etme ve finansal modelleme yapma yöntemi.
yontem.alinti: The first is market researcher... The second is the model builder... Then there's the earnings reviewer.

akis.alinti: Give it any stock and it can pull together the latest news, analyst ratings, and company announcements automatically.
Give it a company and it can build a financial model and excel, estimate what the business could be worth, and break down the risks.
Give it an earnings call and it'll break down what management actually said and help you test whether your investment thesis still makes sense.

yazi: Market Researcher, Model Builder, Earnings Reviewer
